Delhi High Court Rules on Intimate Photos in Divorce Case

The Delhi High Court has decided not to initiate contempt proceedings against a husband and his lawyers for submitting a wife's intimate photos in a divorce petition. The court acknowledged an apology, ordered the photos sealed, and highlighted the breach of personal dignity involved.
